actor.mode-memory-admission.definition: A memory-admission-local operation-mode slot for the actor associated with assessing durable semantic reliance.
actor.mode-memory-admission.applicability: The template reserves the slot, while the synthetic admission has no actor parent; decision_authority_ref and operator_acceptance remain separate.
actor.mode-memory-admission.observed_state: One template has null mode and one synthetic admission has an absent actor parent; no populated admission actor.mode was observed.
actor.mode-memory-admission.reader_consequence: Show admission stage and authority separately from an unpopulated actor mode; do not treat a decision authority reference as actor.mode.
actor.mode-memory-admission.extractor_consequence: Preserve null and absent states; do not populate mode from operator acceptance, decision stage, target use or source-support actors.
actor.mode-memory-admission.query_consequence: Scope mode queries to admission records and revisions; distinguish an actor slot from the admission gate and its target.
actor.mode-memory-admission.migration_consequence: Do not infer an admission mode or global vocabulary; retain the unresolved actor state and re-entry condition.
unresolved_questions: What activity does a populated admission actor.mode describe?
Which authority, if any, may populate it without collapsing decision authority and actor provenance?

actor.mode-preservation-decision.definition: A preservation-decision-local operation-mode slot for the actor associated with recording a prior-value disposition.
actor.mode-preservation-decision.applicability: The template reserves the slot with null children; no populated preservation decision was found in the selected native set.
actor.mode-preservation-decision.observed_state: The single selected preservation template has actor.mode null; no parent-absent or populated preservation actor occurs.
actor.mode-preservation-decision.reader_consequence: Keep operation mode separate from preserved/superseded/rejected/unresolved disposition and operator review.
actor.mode-preservation-decision.extractor_consequence: Populate only from direct preservation-record evidence; do not inherit mode from the old card, new destination, run or source support.
actor.mode-preservation-decision.query_consequence: Query preservation actor mode by decision revision and preserve the disposition as its own field.
actor.mode-preservation-decision.migration_consequence: Retain null and defer any mode vocabulary or requiredness policy; preservation of old value does not supply actor mode.
unresolved_questions: Does a future mode describe comparison, decision recording or application of a preservation disposition?
What direct event evidence would distinguish those activities?

actor.mode-relationship-edge.definition: A relationship-edge-local operation-mode slot for the actor associated with creating or revising the edge assertion.
actor.mode-relationship-edge.applicability: The template is null and the synthetic edge has no actor parent; endpoint roles, direction and relation type are separate.
actor.mode-relationship-edge.observed_state: One template edge has null mode and one synthetic edge has an absent actor parent; no populated edge actor.mode was observed.
actor.mode-relationship-edge.reader_consequence: Keep edge actor mode distinct from endpoint_roles, direction, relation meaning and endpoint provenance.
actor.mode-relationship-edge.extractor_consequence: Do not copy endpoint roles, endpoint actor values or support actor mode into the edge actor slot.
actor.mode-relationship-edge.query_consequence: Edge mode lookup must be edge/revision scoped and cannot be satisfied by an endpoint or relation label.
actor.mode-relationship-edge.migration_consequence: Preserve absent/null edge states and defer mode vocabulary, requiredness and endpoint inheritance.
unresolved_questions: What event or activity would a populated edge actor.mode identify?
How should editorial edge creation be distinguished from source-reported relation extraction?

actor.mode-source-locator.definition: A source-locator-local operation-mode slot for the actor associated with resolving or recording a material address.
actor.mode-source-locator.applicability: The locator template reserves the slot with null children; no populated or absent-parent locator record occurs in the selected set.
actor.mode-source-locator.observed_state: The single selected locator template has actor.mode null and no populated locator actor.mode was observed.
actor.mode-source-locator.reader_consequence: Keep locator type/value, source identity and resolution observation distinct from actor mode.
actor.mode-source-locator.extractor_consequence: Do not derive mode from a locator coordinate, prepared-source mapping, snapshot identity or source author.
actor.mode-source-locator.query_consequence: Locator mode queries must select the locator actor slot and revision, not a source or resolution status field.
actor.mode-source-locator.migration_consequence: Retain null and unresolved mapping limitations; defer any resolver-mode vocabulary or requiredness rule.
unresolved_questions: Does a populated locator actor.mode describe resolution, extraction or reporting?
What direct evidence links a locator actor to a failed or successful lookup?

actor.mode-source-support.definition: A source-support-local operation-mode observation attached to the actor who recorded the support-to-subject/span comparison.
actor.mode-source-support.applicability: Four populated pilot supports record agent-direct; the source-support template is null. This applies to the support record, not its subject claim.
actor.mode-source-support.observed_state: Four exact pilot support paths record agent-direct with actor id codex-cc; one template has null mode; no support parent is absent.
actor.mode-source-support.reader_consequence: Render agent-direct with support-record and revision context; do not transfer it to the supported claim, source author or evidence grade.
actor.mode-source-support.extractor_consequence: Preserve the exact support actor value and the source-span comparison; do not normalize it into a universal extraction mode.
actor.mode-source-support.query_consequence: Support mode queries must scope the support record and subject_ref separately; a support actor is not the actor of its subject claim.
actor.mode-source-support.migration_consequence: Retain four populated and one null state with pilot context; do not backfill admission, edge, locator or validation modes.
unresolved_questions: Does agent-direct describe support extraction, support comparison or the whole pilot run?
What evidence would distinguish support-record actor mode from card or run mode?

actor.mode-validation-result.definition: A validation-result-local operation-mode slot for the actor associated with performing or recording a structural check.
actor.mode-validation-result.applicability: The validation-result template reserves the slot with null children; validator_identity and method_and_settings remain separate.
actor.mode-validation-result.observed_state: The single selected validation template has actor.mode null and no populated validation result actor.mode was observed.
actor.mode-validation-result.reader_consequence: Keep structural result outcome and validator identity separate from an unpopulated actor mode.
actor.mode-validation-result.extractor_consequence: Do not infer mode from validator_identity, method, settings, check outcome or verification status.
actor.mode-validation-result.query_consequence: Validation mode queries must target the result actor and revision, not validator identity or validation_result.
actor.mode-validation-result.migration_consequence: Preserve null and defer a mode vocabulary, requiredness and semantic-verification inheritance.
unresolved_questions: What activity does a populated validation actor.mode represent?
How can a result actor be distinguished from validator identity without duplicating authority?

actor.role-memory-admission.definition: A memory-admission-local activity-role slot for the actor associated with assessing reliance permission.
actor.role-memory-admission.applicability: The template exposes null role and the synthetic admission omits actor; decision_authority_ref and operator acceptance are not actor.role.
actor.role-memory-admission.observed_state: One template has null role and one synthetic admission has an absent parent; no populated admission actor.role was observed.
actor.role-memory-admission.reader_consequence: Keep admit/reject/defer, decision authority and operator acceptance distinct from actor role.
actor.role-memory-admission.extractor_consequence: Do not copy extractor, verifier or operator labels into admission actor.role without direct evidence.
actor.role-memory-admission.query_consequence: Admission actor-role lookup must remain separate from the target's reliance scope and decision outcome.
actor.role-memory-admission.migration_consequence: Retain absent/null states and defer any role vocabulary, authority join or requiredness policy.
unresolved_questions: What role could a direct admission actor carry?
Would that role describe assessment, authorization or recording?

actor.role-preservation-decision.definition: A preservation-decision-local activity-role slot for the actor associated with recording prior-value disposition.
actor.role-preservation-decision.applicability: The preservation template exposes null role; disposition, unique value and operator review are separate lifecycle concerns.
actor.role-preservation-decision.observed_state: The only selected preservation record is the template with null role; no populated role was observed.
actor.role-preservation-decision.reader_consequence: Do not label preserved, superseded, rejected or unresolved value as an actor role.
actor.role-preservation-decision.extractor_consequence: Do not infer role from the old/new destination, source support, operator review or run refs.
actor.role-preservation-decision.query_consequence: Preservation actor role and disposition queries must remain separate and revision-scoped.
actor.role-preservation-decision.migration_consequence: Keep the template null and defer role vocabulary and cross-record inheritance.
unresolved_questions: Which direct role, if any, belongs to a preservation decision actor?
How would it remain distinct from a reconciler or operator authority?

actor.role-relationship-edge.definition: A relationship-edge-local activity-role slot for the actor associated with creating or revising the relation assertion.
actor.role-relationship-edge.applicability: The template has null role and the synthetic edge has no actor; endpoint_roles are roles of endpoints, not this actor.
actor.role-relationship-edge.observed_state: One template edge has null role and one synthetic edge has an absent parent; no populated edge actor.role was observed.
actor.role-relationship-edge.reader_consequence: Keep endpoint_roles, relation meaning and actor role visibly separate.
actor.role-relationship-edge.extractor_consequence: Do not promote endpoint_roles, source author, verifier or support actor role into edge actor.role.
actor.role-relationship-edge.query_consequence: Edge actor-role lookup must select the edge actor slot and cannot be satisfied by endpoint role matches.
actor.role-relationship-edge.migration_consequence: Preserve absent/null edge role and defer an editorial/extraction vocabulary or endpoint inheritance rule.
unresolved_questions: What direct role would identify an edge creator or reviser?
How should inferred/editorial and source-reported edge roles differ?

actor.role-source-locator.definition: A source-locator-local activity-role slot for the actor associated with resolving or reporting a source address.
actor.role-source-locator.applicability: The locator template has null role; locator type/value and resolution observations remain material/address concerns.
actor.role-source-locator.observed_state: The selected locator template has null role and no populated locator actor.role was observed.
actor.role-source-locator.reader_consequence: Do not call a locator resolver, source author or prepared-source process an actor role without direct record evidence.
actor.role-source-locator.extractor_consequence: Preserve locator mapping and access caveats separately; do not infer role from a successful or failed lookup.
actor.role-source-locator.query_consequence: Locator actor role and locator resolution/status queries require distinct predicates.
actor.role-source-locator.migration_consequence: Retain null and defer role vocabulary, requiredness and source-author equivalence.
unresolved_questions: Does a populated locator role describe resolving, reporting or mapping?
What evidence would warrant a role without turning source identity into actor identity?

actor.role-source-support.definition: A source-support-local activity-role observation attached to the actor who recorded the support-to-span comparison.
actor.role-source-support.applicability: Four populated pilot supports record extractor with id codex-cc; the support template is null. The label belongs to support records, not their claim subjects.
actor.role-source-support.observed_state: Four exact pilot support paths record extractor/agent-direct with codex-cc; one template has null role; no support parent is absent.
actor.role-source-support.reader_consequence: Render extractor as a support-record activity label with support and revision scope; do not call it source author, validator or claim actor.
actor.role-source-support.extractor_consequence: Preserve exact label, subject_ref and source-span caveats; do not propagate extractor to the subject claim, card or admission.
actor.role-source-support.query_consequence: Support actor.role and subject actor.role are separate joins; support labels cannot answer claim authorship or validation queries.
actor.role-source-support.migration_consequence: Retain four populated pilot observations and the null template state; do not normalize extractor into a global role enum.
unresolved_questions: Does extractor describe selecting spans, writing support records or a combined pilot task?
What direct evidence would separate support extraction from source authorship and verification?

actor.role-validation-result.definition: A validation-result-local activity-role slot for the actor associated with performing or recording a structural check.
actor.role-validation-result.applicability: The validation template has null role; validator_identity, method_and_settings and validation_result are separate fields.
actor.role-validation-result.observed_state: The selected validation template has null role and no populated validation result actor.role was observed.
actor.role-validation-result.reader_consequence: Keep validator_identity and structural outcome separate from the unpopulated actor role.
actor.role-validation-result.extractor_consequence: Do not infer role from checker identity, test method, outcome, warning or semantic verification.
actor.role-validation-result.query_consequence: Validation actor-role queries must target the actor slot and revision, not validator_identity or result status.
actor.role-validation-result.migration_consequence: Preserve null and defer role vocabulary, requiredness and reviewer/validator inheritance.
unresolved_questions: What direct activity role could a validation result actor carry?
How should it remain distinct from validator identity and independent verification?
